'''Lonnaw''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located on the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]]. It served as the first scheduled stop on the shakedown cruise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|exploratory]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. [[12 ABY/Legends|Thirty-nine]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Lonnaw was temporarily [[Battle of Lonnaw|captured]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Description==
Lonnaw was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|261|Lonnaw}}</ref> located in the [[Lonnaw system/Legends|Lonnaw system]],<ref name="Outbound" /> within the [[Droma sector/Legends|Droma sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions. The [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked the planet to the [[Orinda system/Legends|Orinda]] and [[Obredaan system/Legends|Obredaan systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> with at least five more [[Star system/Legends|systems]] being located between Lonnaw and the world of [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==History==
[[File:Orinda-systems.png|thumb|left|200px|Lonnaw was captured by the Imperial Remnant in 12 ABY.]]
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which depicts the launch of the [[Outbound Flight Project]], to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] on a [[Outbound Flight Project|mission]] to [[Scout/Legends|explore]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], launched from the<ref name="Outbound" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Yaga">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Yaga Minor system/Legends|Yaga Minor system]]</ref> planet [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]]. As the first scheduled stop in a three-[[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long shakedown cruise, the ''Outbound Flight'' visited Lonnaw for a routine [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] check,<ref name="Outbound" /> leaving afterward for the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Argai Minor system/Legends|Argai Minor system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Lonnaw fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. It was [[Battle of Lonnaw|seized]] by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], however, as part of a [[Orinda campaign|series]] of conquests of Republic systems. Lonnaw was the most [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] of the Remnant's captured holdings from Orinda. The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] entrenched themselves at Lonnaw but eventually fell back to Orinda after a number of skirmishes against the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|forces]] of the New Republic.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lonnaw was first mentioned in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the planet within grid square K-6.<ref name="TEA" />
